agyos_skill.instructions: The **Groups-as-organic-surface strategy** — build a niche group as a community asset (10–30× Page reach) and grow it value-first. The agent **designs the strategy + drafts the group posts + drafts the Page/cross-channel content that drives joins**; **WoopSocial publishes the Page + cross-channel funnel content (not group posts)**; **in-group posting, admin, and moderation are human/native → `community-management`.** **Pages are dying organically** (~1.4–1.65% reach), while **Groups reach 40–50% of members per post** — a **10–30× multiplier** (a 10k-member group reaches 4,000–5,000 vs a Page's ~137–600). With **1.8B monthly Group users** across **10M+ groups**, Facebook **deliberately favors Groups** (the Andromeda AI reads back-and-forth conversation as **meaningful social interaction**). The mindset is **community engineering, not broadcasting**: a niche **Private (Visible)** group as a compounding asset, **value first, trust second, sales third.** WoopSocial can't post to Groups — it publishes the **Page + cross-channel content that funnels people to join**, while the group itself is native. 1. **brand-profile** — niche/voice. 2. **goals-and-kpis** — community vs leads vs paid membership. (Depth: `references/the-tribe-framework.md`.) - **T — Treat it as a community asset, not a broadcast:** niche, keyword-rich, **Private (Visible)**, 2–3 membership questions + rules. The 10–30× goldmine. - **R — Run two-way engagement daily:** varied posts, **polls**, short-form video (~3×); respond in the **first 30–60 min** (velocity/MSI); never post-and-ghost. - **I — Invite quality, not blasts:** email list + social (~30% acceptance / ~40% retention), non-competing admin partnerships, a lead magnet, ads to the join link, **genuine** cross-posting (200–500/month). *No bulk-poster automation or bought members (ToS/ban risk).* - **B — Build trust before selling:** value first → trust → sales; **no selling in the first 30 days**; a warm niche → ~20–23% conversion / $3–15K/mo. - **E — Extend from the Page (group stays native):** **WoopSocial publishes the Page + cross-channel content that drives joins**; in-group posting, admin, moderation + analytics are human/native →
